title: Measure Appointment Allowances and Fees by Ridgeline Door Series
content:
Measure appointment allowances and fees for Entry & Patio Door Contracts, by door series.

| Door series | Final measure offered within | Reschedule notice for an on-time reschedule | Missed appointments waived per contract | Fee per missed appointment beyond the waived count | Free customer-requested remeasures per contract | Fee per customer-requested remeasure beyond the free count |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door | 10 business days | 24 hours | 1 | $75.00 | 0 | $125.00 |
| Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door | 10 business days | 24 hours | 1 | $75.00 | 1 | $125.00 |
| Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door | 10 business days | 24 hours | 1 | $85.00 | 1 | $135.00 |
| Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door | 8 business days | 24 hours | 1 | $85.00 | 1 | $135.00 |
| Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door | 8 business days | 24 hours | 1 | $95.00 | 1 | $150.00 |
| Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | 7 business days | 24 hours | 1 | $125.00 | 2 | $175.00 |

## Definitions

- **Final measure offered within**: the number of business days after the booking deposit is received in full within which a final measure appointment is offered.
- **Reschedule notice**: the minimum notice before a measure appointment's start for a customer reschedule to count as on-time.
- **Missed appointments waived**: the number of missed measure appointments per contract waived before the missed-appointment fee applies.
- **Free remeasures**: the number of customer-requested remeasure visits per contract that carry no fee.

## Reading across the series

| Series | First missed appointment | Second missed appointment | First customer-requested remeasure | Second customer-requested remeasure | Third customer-requested remeasure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door | no fee | $75.00 | $125.00 | $125.00 | $125.00 |
| Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | no fee | $125.00 | no fee | no fee | $175.00 |

These two rows are read straight from the schedule above: the Portal 310 waives one missed appointment and has no free remeasure; the Hinge 960 waives one missed appointment and has two free remeasures. The reschedule notice is 24 hours in every series.
